LANL Contributions to Collaborating Sites In a spirit of collaboration, the LANL team joined forces with ANL, ORNL, and INL, providing full builds for testing and facilitating a comprehensive exchange of information. To enable each site to conduct their own post-processing and analysis, all builds were deliberately left untreated. The team shared detailed processing parameters, layouts, lasing orders, and other essential information, ensuring that each site could replicate the build if needed. This collaborative effort yielded a wealth of additional data, enriching the work packages and datasets of all participating laboratories. As shown in Figure 43, a notable milestone was achieved by mid-FY24, with the successful completion of builds using Praxair and PAC powders for ANL, ORNL, INL, and LANL. Throughout the process, LANL maintained a rigorous machine schedule, allowing the other sites to test specimens independently and compare the resulting behaviors based on different fabrication systems. This coordinated approach fostered a deeper understanding of the underlying mechanisms and paved the way for further research and discovery.
